headline: Names a Minneapolis, Minnesota Postal Service facility the Martin Olav Sabo Post Office.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 100 South 1st Street in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The new name honors Martin Olav Sabo, a former member of the U.S. House of Representatives. The change is symbolic and does not change how the post office operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation applies from that date.
